shared_elements: upright slab with carved relief on the broad face
vertical framing bands or panels along the edges of the field
figural scene divided into upper and lower zones
justification: Both are upright carved slabs whose broad face carries human figures within a bordered field divided into upper and lower zones, which is the most specific correspondence but also a very generic monument scheme. A shows a narrative scene of armed figures above a horse and rider trampling a serpent inside a zigzag/interlace border, while B shows a single blocky standing figure flanked by columns of small repeated sign-like blocks, with no animals, no rider and no interlace ornament.
